mentions.author: fionaellie
mentions.story: Toyota owners have to pay $8/month to keep using their key fob for remote start
mentions.why: Shows hard-to-find emergency release; none in back seat.
mentions.quote: it's quite hard to find, and if you're in the back seat, there's no emergency mechanism at all.

mentions.author: michaelt
mentions.story: Early owners of Tesla's Model 3 are reporting quality problems
mentions.why: Review reporting poor fit and finish on Model 3.
mentions.quote: reported really poor fit and finish quality - rattling doors, poorly fitted gaps around the trunk
